approved_to_delivery_wall_seconds.source: Explicit approval and first effective scoped delivery timestamps

mechanical_event_count.source: Actual measured same-unit mechanical event references; scientific changes separate

first_pass.source: Attempt-linked first reviewable delivery and review outcome; not package passed flag

preparation_wall_seconds.source: Existing preparation receipt timer; not end-to-end workflow time

zero_baseline: Relative improvement undefined/null; retain absolute difference only when matched
stopped_vs_failed: Explicit STOPPED intent remains separate from FAILED; do not infer from unavailable completion
exclusions: Missing identity/definition, mismatched group/scope, frozen backend provenance and unmeasured values stay outside applicable denominators
next_observation: Next already-authorized preparation or retrieval only; record from its actual start in existing receipt; no new task or background mechanism
internal_operator_trial_limits: Existing internal management agent; not external independent or blind first-time trial. One usability demonstration, no efficiency claim; human time and improvement remain null.
